height_reference: normalised DSM: last-return DSM minus DTM at each cell
source: Environment Agency 2022 LIDAR Composite DSM (last/only return) and DTM, 1 m, Open Government Licence v3. Source surveys span 2000-2022; exact acquisition date varies by location and must be read from the metadata index.
accuracy_note: The source surveys are reported at about +/-15 cm vertical RMSE, but the composite is merged/resampled and the 1 m product cannot resolve a narrow duct.
caveat: Use for roofscape/context massing and orientation only. Do not infer a flue height, installation date or source-receptor separation from a single cell.
